q2_gaps: An adjectivally-modified bare plural serving as a NON-SPECIFIC kind-level object ("enforces strict standards"): the adjective+noun fusion test decides by exemplar lists (fuse for a term of art / nationality / role title / material adjective; never for incidental description = colour, size, damage, mood) and a qualitative adjective like "strict" falls in neither list, while the plural split rule sends a descriptive modifier to the group-distributive rule, which the bare-kind-filler route (no group witness) has no way to build — so the modifier has no licensed slot other than fusion.
notes: "the Stilllight Lantern" correctly takes the multi-word-name treatment (one opaque symbol + Name + the kind word from inside the name as an ordinary type atom), while "the Council" correctly stays a bare capitalized common noun with no Name. Given the fusion choice, the genus plus gradable-adjective modifier genus are both correctly emitted at definitional TV.
